text:
Try and find pairs of numbers around your house so that one number is 10 times larger than the other.

You can ignore any units during this activity.
So whatever the number represents (e.g. mass, volume, time, a number of things) doesn't matter.

For example, if you can find a clock that has the number 12 on it and a bar of chocolate that is 120g then you have found one pair.

How many pairs can you find in 10 minutes?
